name: Gfx_Texture_InitDesc
signature: void Gfx_Texture_InitDesc(unsigned int* desc, unsigned int cpuAddr, unsigned int vaddr, unsigned char format, unsigned short width, unsigned short height, unsigned short arg7, unsigned int size, unsigned char flag)
summary: Fills a 0x14-byte texture/image descriptor: CPU pointer at +0, physical address (vaddr >> 3 after Os_VirtualToPhysical) at +4, width/height at +8/+0xa, a third u16 at +0xc, format byte at +0xe, flag byte at +0xf and size >> 3 at +0x10; vaddr 0 means 'no physical address'.
evidence: Called by 0x00558FF4, 0x00559144, 0x00559220 and 0x0055A28C. Only callee is Os_VirtualToPhysical (0x0012345C); body writes *desc=cpuAddr, desc[1]=phys>>3 (when vaddr!=0), *(u8*)(desc+0xe)=format, desc[4]=size>>3, *(u16*)(desc+0xa)=width, *(u16*)(desc+2)=height, *(u16*)(desc+3)=param7, *(u8*)(desc+0xf)=flag. Default call in the Font ctors is (0,0,8,0,0,0,0,1) = empty descriptor with format 8.

name: Gfx_ParseChipFile
signature: unsigned int Gfx_ParseChipFile(GfxChipFile* self, const void* data, unsigned int heap)
summary: Parses a 'CHIP' 2D-background container (RomFS '2d/bg/<map>/<map>.chp', 485 files): checks the magic/version template, reads the section count at +0xC and the section-table offset at +0xE, resolves the seven named sections (Header, Areas, AnimRGBA, AnimData, CharacterDepth, Name, BlockData00), stores their pointers in self (+0xC..+0x24), derives the pixel/aspect ratios with 0x0055A2BC and Mem_AllocAligned-allocates one 0x14-byte record per entry.
evidence: Format confirmed against the shipped assets, not just the code: 485 files named game_data/packs/2d/bg/<map>/<map>.chp start with the same header - 'CHIP' (0x50494843) +0, fileSize +4 (b001_101a.chp: 0x19210 = 102,928 = exact file length), BOM 0xFEFF + version 0x0102 +8 (the same bytes the parser compares against, stored literally at 0x00564B38: 'CHIP\0\0\0\0' 02 01 00 00), u16 section count 7 at +0xC, u16 section-table offset 0x18 at +0xE, then seven absolute section offsets at +0x18 (0x6C, 0xE8, 0x170, 0x1A8, 0x210, 0x23C, 0x29C). Each section is a 0x28-byte header {u16 headerSize=0x28, u16 flags, u32 payloadSize, char name[0x20]} followed by its payload, e.g. 'Header' at 0x6C (payload 0x54), 'Areas' at 0xE8 (0x60), 'AnimRGBA' 0x170, 'AnimData' 0x1A8, 'CharacterDepth' 0x210 (flags 3), 'Name' 0x23C (flags 1), 'BlockData00' 0x29C (0x18F4C bytes) - which matches the chain walk cur + u16@0 + u32@4 + u16@2 used in the body. Caller 0x002BD558 passes the loaded RomFS file plus a per-resource offset. Return 1 on success, 0 on bad magic/version.

name: Text_ReleaseBuffer
summary: Releases the run's heap block: when +0x28 is set it subtracts the 8-byte header and calls the global operator delete, clearing the field.
evidence: if (self->f_28) { 0x0010F69C(self->f_28 - 8); self->f_28 = 0; }. 0x0010F69C/0x0010F6CC are the allocator delete paths used across the tree.

name: Gfx_Material_ResolveTextures
summary: Resolves the material's texture indices into real texture objects: after resetting the sub-object at self+8, it looks up the three u8 indices at desc+0x1f..0x21 in the descriptor's pointer table and binds them at self+0x58/+0x5c/+0x60, plus the base/animated texture indices into self+0x1c/+0x40/+0x4c according to the mode byte at self+0x64 (0, 1 or 2 textures).
evidence: Callers FUN_0049D84C, FUN_004E2A70, FUN_005A8000 (shared scene/battle/UI draw paths). Callees FUN_005644E0 (arg1+8 reset), FUN_00712BBC (388b) and FUN_00712FEC/FUN_0071312C - three setters taking a resolved resource pointer plus a destination field; index table is *(u32*)(*(int*)(*(int*)(arg1+4)+0xc) + idx*4) with 0xff meaning 'none'; destinations 0x1c, 0x40, 0x4c, 0x58, 0x5c, 0x60 and mode switch on the byte at arg1+100 (0x64).

name: maybe_Container_InitListObject
summary: Small list/array container constructor: installs vtable 0x00782080, builds two self-referential link pairs, stores the owner twice, zeroes six u16 counters and constructs the inline four-byte-element array at +0x28.
evidence: No caller and no named callee; vtable 0x00782080 has no other user in the readable tree, so neither the owner class nor the element type can be determined.

name: Container_MultiList_Dtor
summary: Destructor of a container that owns several intrusive red-black trees/lists: unlinks the four list heads, erases every node of the tree at +0x1C and returns the object.
evidence: The body is the standard intrusive-container teardown (repeated unlink pairs, successor-walk erase) and it is installed as a vtable dtor; the exact container class is unknown, hence the generic name.

name: Pack_IsTextResourceName
summary: Returns 1 when a resource name contains the text/script suffixes .bxon, .bspa or .bact, i.e. classifies the member as a text/data resource rather than a binary asset. The three suffix literals are the only data used; there is no caller in the readable tree because it is reached through a resource-table callback.
evidence: std_strstr(name,".bxon") || .bspa || .bact; strings at 0x55AE90/0x55AE98/0x55AEA0; function pointer at 0x6823B0 in a resource dispatch table

name: Gfx_ModelPart_Dtor
summary: Destructor shim for a model part: releases its buffer pair (0x5799D4) and then the object reference (0x10F6CC).
evidence: Destructor shim for model part; releases buffer pair via 0x005799D4 and frees memory with operator delete (0x0010F6CC).

name: Gfx_Overlay_AddQuad
signature: void Gfx_Overlay_AddQuad(GfxOverlay* self, const void* quad, int scale)
summary: Appends one screen-space quad to the global 2D batch: after a one-time init of the singleton at 0x008384A0 (memset 0x140, vtable 0x00782AFC), it converts the descriptor's pixel rect and UVs into normalised coordinates using the screen mode (320x240 for mode 2, 400x480 otherwise), picks a palette colour when the descriptor's colour index is >= 0, and writes the 0x48-byte (18-word) vertex record (pos, size, uv, 8 colour words, 3 table colours, flag) at buffer[count*0x48], incrementing the count.
evidence: Callers FUN_002D3C1C (maybe_Gfx_Overlay_DrawFourQuads) and FUN_002D4604 - the 2D overlay drawing paths, same pair that calls 0x0055CB58/0x0055CCB4. Body: singleton flag *g_007BE38C, buffer base from literal 0x008384A0, memset 0x140 via FUN_00116AE0, vtable 0x00782AFC, std_ConstructArray(puVar5+10, 0x0051CF40, 4); screen-size selection self->f_24==2 -> 0x140/0xf0 else 400/0x1e0; UV/rect fields read from arg2->f_1c..f_30, colours from f_32..f_3b and palette index f_3c (table entry bytes +0x74/0x75/0x76 scaled by 0x3B808081), current colour from g_007E2030, target record stride 0x48 with the write cursor piVar6[2].

name: Gfx_CharShadowPass_Create
signature: unsigned int Gfx_CharShadowPass_Create(GfxCharShadowPass* self, unsigned int ctx, unsigned int heap)
summary: Allocates the character-shadow-pass resources: it builds five resource descriptors (slots 0-5 with sizes 0xec0/0xc00 and formats 3/1) and registers them through 0x0055F8B8 on the current command list, then allocates a 0x1800-byte block (128 objects of 0x30 bytes) with Mem_AllocAligned and constructs it with 0x0055B980, clearing the cursor at self[7].
evidence: Caller Gfx_CharShadowPass_Init (0x002D4F28) - authoritative name. Callees maybe_Gfx_CmdList_GetSingleton (0x006F2394), maybe_Gfx_ResourceTable_InsertRange (0x0055F8B8), Mem_AllocAligned (size 0x1800, align 4) and std_ConstructArray with ctor 0x0055B980, element size 0x30, count 0x80 (0x80*0x30 = 0x1800). Stack descriptors: {0,1,0xec0,3}, {2,-1,0xc00,1}, {3,-1,0xc00,1}, {4,-1,0xc00,1}, {5,-1,0xc00,1}; REF literal 0x0055B980; returns 1.

name: Text_LayoutGlyphRunTwoPass
signature: void Text_LayoutGlyphRunTwoPass(Text_Layout* self, unsigned context, GlyphRun* run, Text_Row* row, unsigned flags)
summary: Lays out one glyph run for a text row: computes the run box (0x1E0x140 or 0xF0x140 for two-line mode), scales the glyph positions to the box and emits the quads twice through Text_BuildGlyphQuads - once per texture page.
evidence: The decompile is slightly damaged: its unaff_r7 is the box width (400/0x140) that Ghidra dropped, so the shape was verified in the ARM listing: 0x0055B468 starts with `ff4f2de9` (push) and contains two `bl #0x55B984` at 0x0055B6C8 and 0x0055B6FC in asm/text/text_00540048.s - the same glyph-quad emitter invoked twice (page 0 and 1) after two strlen calls (0x0011CD80). The callers Gfx_SubmitSortedElement / maybe_Gfx_Overlay_DrawFourQuads are the text submit paths.

name: Text_CharFilter_Match
signature: u32 Text_CharFilter_Match(int self, u8* outVisible, int charRecord, int kind, u32 filter, int inRect, int x, int y, int minX, int maxX, int minY, int maxY, u32 layerMask)
summary: Decides whether one glyph is drawn: compares the glyph's layer/type bits (byte +2 & 0x1F, >>5) with the requested filter, tests the glyph rectangle against the clip rectangle and the 1<<(layer-1) layer mask, and returns 1 (draw) or 0 (skip) while also writing the decision to outVisible.
evidence: The caller Text_BuildGlyphQuads (0.50) and the 0x1F bit-field / 1<<(layer-1) convention are visible in the body; the previous doc claimed it 'always returns 1', but the body has eight 'return 0' branches, so it is a real predicate and the name holds.

name: Text_BuildGlyphQuads
signature: void Text_BuildGlyphQuads(int self, u32 count, u32 * chars, float * layout, int line, float * clip, int arg7, u32 arg8, u32 arg9, u32 arg10, float scale)
summary: Lays out the text of one line into 0x48-byte glyph quads: for every character it resolves the glyph metrics, clips to the visible rectangle, filters by layer, computes the screen/world quad corners and UVs and writes the instance array. This is the core text renderer: it calls 0x663FB8 Text_BuildCharTransform and the 0x663xxx glyph-metric helpers, and its output stride 0x48 matches the text instance format.
evidence: uses maybe_Text_BuildCharTransform(0x663FB8), glyph metrics 0x6638D8/0x6639E4/0x663B78/0x663D74/0x6648C0, Text_CharFilter_Match(0x55B71C); writes 0x12-word records to self->f_1C/self->f_20; constants 0.5/0.25/0.125/0.0156; scale arg11

name: maybe_Text_BuildGlyphQuadsThumb
signature: void maybe_Text_BuildGlyphQuadsThumb(int self, u32 count, float * chars, float * layout)
summary: Thumb fragment of the glyph-quad builder: the same per-character transform/UV loop as Text_BuildGlyphQuads (0x0055B984), which appears both as its caller and as its callee, so this is a mid-function split symbol rather than a separate routine. The body is damaged (unaff_r6/unaff_r7, BADSPACEBASE), so nothing beyond glyph-quad code is verifiable.
evidence: The callee list contains 0x0055B984 Text_BuildGlyphQuads, which is also the only caller: the signature of a split symbol inside that function (FACTS.md: mid-function split symbols cause fake truncation). The remaining callees (Font_GetGlyphCell, Font_GetGlyphQuadUV, Text_BuildCharTransform) confirm glyph-quad code and rule out item lookups, but the damaged frame keeps the confidence at 0.3.

name: Gfx_CmdList_BindTexture
signature: void Gfx_CmdList_BindTexture(unsigned int* table, unsigned int unit, int index, unsigned int ctx)
summary: Binds one texture object from a per-pass resource table into the current PICA command list: it obtains the singleton command list for ctx and passes the resource at table[index+1] (offset table+4+index*4) plus the target unit to 0x0055FC5C.
evidence: Called from 20+ known Gfx_ModelInstance_Draw*Pass functions (e.g. Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawWithGxState, maybe_Gfx_ModelInstance_DrawShadowPass, ...DrawFinalPass) plus FUN_002D4604/FUN_00563DB0/FUN_00578868 - i.e. every model/material pass binds its texture. Callees maybe_Gfx_CmdList_GetSingleton (0x006F2394) and FUN_0055FC5C (476b, the command-list texture setter); resource lookup *(u32*)(arg1 + arg3*4 + 4) with arg3 = index, arg4 forwarded to the singleton getter as a stack copy.

name: Gfx_SubmitScreenQuad
signature: void Gfx_SubmitScreenQuad(unsigned arg1, unsigned target, unsigned x, unsigned y)
summary: Submits a screen-space quad: derives the source rectangle from the current viewport (0x56C738) and forwards it to the draw-command builder (0x6F19A8).
evidence: The callers are the same UI draw functions as the glyph/quad helpers (0x2D3C1C, 0x2D4604) and the rectangle resolution uses the named Gfx_Resource_FindSizeRecord, so the submit-screen-quad reading holds.

name: Gfx_State_SetAlphaBlend
signature: void Gfx_State_SetAlphaBlend(unsigned int arg1, GfxState* state, char blendEnable)
summary: Configures the packed alpha-blend state of the overlay state object: it starts from a default descriptor produced by 0x0050971C and, when blending is enabled, selects blend factors (4/3/0x0e/0x0f) and encodes the alpha byte from the float argument passed in s0 (value * 255), then applies the descriptor to state[1] via 0x00658050.
evidence: Callers FUN_002D3C1C (maybe_Gfx_Overlay_DrawFourQuads) and FUN_002D4604 - the overlay drawing pair; callees FUN_0050971C (builds the 0x28-byte default descriptor at &local_b0) and FUN_00658050(&local_b0, oldWord) whose result is stored at *(u32*)(arg2+4). Font/style: float in s0 multiplied by 0x437F0000 (255.0f) then VectorFloatToUnsigned into local_9b; the two branches differ exactly by blend enable (arg3 == 0 sets factors to 0/1/3, else 4/3/0xe/0xf). Param 1 is unused in the body.

name: Gfx_Overlay_FlushQuads
signature: void Gfx_Overlay_FlushQuads(GfxOverlay* self, unsigned int cmd, int* params)
summary: Flushes the accumulated overlay quads: it resets the vertex-buffer write cursor, expands the compact 0x30-byte quad records at self+0x1c (count self->f_20) into 0x48-byte GPU vertex records (position/uv/colours, padding the 0.0 and 1.0 components), advances the buffer count, then issues the draw (0x006F19A8) and the finaliser 0x0055CE34.
evidence: Callers FUN_002D3C1C / FUN_002D4604 (the same overlay pair as 0x0055AEB8/0x0055CB58). Body: early-out if self->f_20 < 1; iVar1 = self->f_18 + self->f_18->f_18*0xc and *(iVar1+4)=*(iVar1+8) (cursor reset); params->f_8/f_10 forwarded through FUN_0056C738 and FUN_006F19A8(arg2,&local_40); loop copies src words [0..0xb] into the 0x48-byte record with 0x00000000 padding and 0x3F800000 fillers (literals 0x0055CE2C/0x0055CE30), then piVar8[2] += f_20 and func_0055CE34(self,arg2). Sibling of 0x0055AEB8 which writes single quads directly.

name: maybe_Gfx_CmdBuf_ValidateSlot
summary: Reads the command buffer's current slot (self->f_18 indexed by its own f_18 word, stride 0xC), computes the base + index*0x48 entry address and, when the slot's end index and write index disagree, falls into the 12 x 0x70-byte construct-array path. The readable C stops at that call because the Thumb CRT helper std_ConstructArray is mis-marked noreturn, so the 540-byte body is not covered.
evidence: All three callers are now named command-buffer/overlay routines (Gfx_SubmitSortedElement, Gfx_Overlay_FlushQuads, Gfx_Overlay_SubmitQuad), which fixes the class, but the readable body ends at std_ConstructArray, the known Thumb blx-to-CRT mis-marking (FACTS.md), so the remaining 500 bytes are unread and the verb stays unproven.

name: maybe_Gfx_SamplerState_Write
summary: Writes a three-byte PICA200 texture-sampler state into the draw command stream: mode 0 sets filter 1 / 0x80 / wrap 6, modes 1 and 2 swap the filter and wrap bytes, then the bytes are appended after the element command and the stream cursor at state+4 is updated.
evidence: Callers are now the generic draw-submit paths Gfx_SubmitSortedElement (0x002D4604) and Gfx_Overlay_SubmitQuad (0x0055D428), not a model instance, and state+4 holds a command-stream cursor; the mode switch only chooses the three sampler bytes (1/0x80/6) which 0x00656ACC appends. The emitting callee Gfx_Pica_EmitDrawElements is itself low-confidence, so the name stays maybe_.

name: maybe_Gfx_ModelInstance_SetSamplerStateB
signature: void maybe_Gfx_ModelInstance_SetSamplerStateB(Gfx_ModelInstance* self, SamplerState* state, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int arg4)
summary: Prepares texture sampler state descriptor with wrap mode 5 and invokes PICA GPU packet encoder 0x00656B24 to update command buffer at state+4.
evidence: Constructs 3-byte sampler state descriptor (flags at +0/+1 and wrap mode 5 at +2) and encodes command packet into buffer via 0x00656B24. No direct callers; keeping maybe_ name and 0.40 confidence.

name: Gfx_CmdBuf_WriteScreenProjection
signature: void Gfx_CmdBuf_WriteScreenProjection(void* state, GfxCmdBuf* cmdbuf, int screen, unsigned int reserved)
summary: Builds an orthographic pixel-to-clip matrix for the given screen (400x240 top or 320x240 bottom) and emits it plus the associated PICA state words into the command buffer, tagging the state object with the screen index. Ghidra's 4th argument is dead (it is only overwritten with 0x1e0/0xf0), so it is treated as scratch.
evidence: arg1->f_24 = arg3; screen==2 selects width 0x140/height 0xf0 else 400/0x1e0. Matrix math from 1.0f (0x3F800000) and 2.0f (0x40000000): local_4a4 = (1.0/-h)*2.0, local_49c = -(h*(1.0/-h)), local_498 = -((1.0/w)*2.0) -> textbook ortho. Emits puVar4[0]=0x8000005A with cmd 0x000F02C0 and data block 0x00BF02C1, then puVar4[0x10]=0x80000056 with 0x000F02C0/0x00FF02C1 (two 8-word matrix blocks), then a 0x000100E0 state word. Callers 0x002D3C1C maybe_Gfx_Overlay_DrawFourQuads and 0x002D4604; f_24 is then read by 0x0055D428 to pick 0xf0/0x1e0.

name: Gfx_Overlay_SubmitQuad
signature: void Gfx_Overlay_SubmitQuad(GfxOverlayState* state, GfxCmdBuf* cmdbuf, GfxNode** node, int* quadDesc, unsigned int limit)
summary: Emits the GPU state for one overlay quad: rewinds the command-buffer slot to its saved mark, writes the texture sampler config and the draw elements, sets up the screen projection and appends the quad through Gfx_Overlay_AddQuad. Called once per render element from Gfx_SubmitSortedElement, so it is a per-quad submit, not a batch begin.
evidence: Its only caller Gfx_SubmitSortedElement submits one render element and calls this next to Gfx_Overlay_AddQuad and Gfx_SubmitScreenQuad, so the 'BeginBatch' reading is wrong; the body rewinds the cmd slot, writes the sampler config and draw elements and ends by constructing the quad descriptor that Gfx_Overlay_AddQuad consumes.

name: Gfx_ModelInstance_SubmitSkinningData
signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_SubmitSkinningData(Gfx_ModelInstance* instance, ModelDrawPacket* packet, unsigned arg3, unsigned arg4)
summary: Packs the model instance's per-vertex skinning data into the render command list: fetches the command-list singleton (0x6F2394) and forwards the packet to 0x55FE38, which appends the bone indices/weights.
evidence: 7 callers including 0x2D2930, 0x2D3C1C, 0x566728, 0x566BA8, 0x5682AC, 0x56AFFC; 0x6F2394 = maybe_Gfx_CmdList_GetSingleton; 0x55FE38 appends skinned vertex data (0x508B9C/0x508BE8)

name: Gfx_ModelInstance_ReleaseResources
summary: Releases a model instance's five bound GPU resources and its heap block.
evidence: Called from 0x002D2850 Gfx_CharShadowPass_Release; body loops i<5 calling func_0055F7E8(global, self[i+1]) to release each resource, clears *self, then frees self[7] with func_0010F69C. The five-resource layout matches Gfx_ModelInstance_Init (0x55DD7C).

name: Font_CalcGlyphScale
signature: void Font_CalcGlyphScale(int glyph, u32 arg2, u32 charCode)
summary: Computes the glyph scale factor 1.0/(charSize+0x20) and stores it in the glyph record's +0x3C word. The +0x20 bias is the standard ETC1/texture-unit padding of the bffnt glyph cell.
evidence: iVar1=func_0066509C(charCode,10); glyph->f_3C = 1.0f / (float)(iVar1+0x20); g_0055d918=1.0f; no callers (helper reached via vtable/table)

name: Gfx_ModelInstance_SetMatrix
signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_SetMatrix(int self, float * matrix, float * scale)
summary: Applies a 4x4 model matrix and a scale vector to a model instance: writes the three scaled basis rows and translation to +0x1A0..+0x1CC, the raw matrix to +0x1D0..+0x1FC and the effective scale to +0x200..+0x220, refreshing the secondary-motion terms. The 12-float matrix layout at +0x1A0/+0x1D0 is the model-instance transform used by the draw code; the guard checks the instance and its linked node.
evidence: if(self+4 && *(self+8)==node->f_C && (func_00659318(node) || node->f_288 || node->+4>0)) writes f_1A0..f_1CC (scale-multiplied), f_1D0..f_1FC (raw), f_200..f_208 (scale), f_21C/f_220; caller 0x001D03F8 maybe_Actor_CheckLinkedState

name: Gfx_Texture_InitDescriptor
signature: bool Gfx_Texture_InitDescriptor(TextureSlot* self, uint32_t heap, uint32_t unusedA, uint32_t unusedB, const uint32_t* sizeAndFormat)
summary: Creates the descriptor for a 0x4E8-byte texture object: rounds the width/height fields up to powers of two, fills a descriptor block and instantiates the object through 0x0053082C.
evidence: g_0055DBAC = 0x4E8 is the allocation size; three fields are rounded with the LZCOUNT power-of-two idiom; the 0x20/1/1 flag bytes match a texture format descriptor; calls 0x0053082C(allocated, &desc) whose vtable is 0x0078122C.

name: Gfx_ModelSlot_Assign
signature: void Gfx_ModelSlot_Assign(void* self, void* resource, int slot, u32 context)
summary: Assigns a model-resource slot: if the slot table at (*(self+4))+0xC already holds an entry it is released through 0x52F6D0, and when a new resource is supplied its handle (resource+4) is installed with Gfx_ModelSlot_Replace using the owner at self+8.
evidence: Both callees are now named and both list this function as their only caller: maybe_Gfx_ModelSlot_Release (0.48) and Gfx_ModelSlot_Replace (0.50), whose docs already say 'the caller is Gfx_BindResourceSlot, so this is model-resource bookkeeping'. That fixes the subsystem the previous pass could only guess.

name: maybe_Gfx_ModelInstance_ReleaseSlotEmittersIfUnused
summary: Drops the emitter group held by one instance slot: when the slot still points at the current resource (slot+8 == resource+0xC) and the resource is either still referenced (0x659318) or flagged (+0x288 / +4), it destroys the group with Fx_Group_DestroyEmitters and clears slot+4.
evidence: The teardown callee is the confident Fx_Group_DestroyEmitters (0.60), not a draw-node release, so the old 'ReleaseDrawNodes' wording was wrong; the two callers (Gfx_Model_DrawOverlayPasses, Gfx_ModelInstance_SetMatrix) are draw-path functions, so when the condition actually fires is still unclear.

name: Gfx_ModelInstance_Init
signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_Init(ModelInstance* out, ModelResource* resource, int index, int frame, uint32_t flags, const float* transform)
summary: Fills a model-instance record from a model resource: selects the animation frame, creates the instance with 0x00530014, copies the 4x4 transform and stores the per-frame scale/alpha derived from the frame byte.
evidence: Indexing *(*(*(arg2+4)+0xC) + arg3*4) selects the model record, arg4*0x3C+0xC indexes the 0x3C-byte frame table, the byte at that offset is converted to float and multiplied by 0.1f (0x3DCCCCCD); 0x00530014 allocates the pool slot; vtable 0x0078215C is written to out[0].

name: Gfx_ModelInstance_InitWithTransform
signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_InitWithTransform(ModelInstance* out, ModelResource* resource, int index, int frame, uint32_t flags, const float* world, const float* scale)
summary: Same as 0x0055DD7C but composes a full world matrix: stores the 4x4 matrix both raw and pre-multiplied by the per-instance scale into the instance record at 0x1A0..0x220.
evidence: Two 4x4 blocks (0x1A0/0x1D0) are written with arg6 values multiplied by arg7 components; the mode/frame lookup arg4*0x3C+0xC is identical to 0x0055DD7C; f_264 receives the packed frame word; callers are the battle cutscene object constructors 0x00360BC0/0x003615A8.

name: Gfx_ModelInstance_UpdateAnimators
signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_UpdateAnimators(unsigned render, unsigned instance, unsigned char channel, unsigned arg4)
summary: Advances the animation/pose chain of a model instance: resets the scene group (0x52E990) and steps the instance's unit list at the given channel (0x52F988).
evidence: Called by confident caller Gfx_Overlay_DrawScreenQuad (0x002D2A54) to step animation/pose chain of model instance.

name: Gfx_ModelInstance_SetPoseMatrix
signature: void Gfx_ModelInstance_SetPoseMatrix(Gfx_ModelInstance* self, InstanceSlot* slot, unsigned node, float* matrix)
summary: Uploads a 4x4 pose matrix for one model node: zeroes the command block, stamps its type word, inverts the matrix translation (last column) and submits it through 0x5255B4.
evidence: Called by confident caller Gfx_Overlay_DrawScreenQuad (0x002D2A54) to upload 4x4 pose matrix commands for model node.

name: Gfx_ModelInstance_ReleaseResource
summary: Releases the model instance's current render resource through its vtable slot +4 (deleting release) and clears both the resource pointer (+4) and the cached handle (+8).
evidence: Releases model instance render resource through vtbl[4] and clears resource pointer (+4) and handle (+8).

name: maybe_Gfx_ModelInstance_DtorLinked
summary: Deleting destructor for a model instance that is linked into a list: stores the class vtable 0x00782714 in the object, unlinks it from its neighbours (self[2]/self[3]) and frees the block.
evidence: Re-reading against the operator-delete callee 0x0010F6CC (header at object-8, vtable+4 release) shows the body destroys state rather than resetting it; the separate confident name Gfx_ModelInstance_Dtor already exists for another address, so this copy's class stays a maybe_.

name: Gfx_BindIndexedResourceSet
signature: bool Gfx_BindIndexedResourceSet(GfxResourceSlot* self, uint32_t heap, ResDesc* desc, ModelInstance* owner)

name: maybe_Container_EraseByKey
summary: Erases the tree entry at the lower bound of a key: walks the red-black tree at container+0x10/+0x18, and when the lower-bound node exists it tears the payload down (stops the timer through func_0010F69C, clears +0x30, destroys the list at +0, frees the block).

name: Model_SimulateSecondaryMotion
signature: void Model_SimulateSecondaryMotion(SecondaryMotionChain* self, const float* ownerMatrix, ModelBoneMatrices* bones)

name: Model_UpdateSecondaryMotion

name: Gfx_CharShadowPass_BuildCommands

summary: Builds the character-shadow pass command list at init time: fills a 0x50-byte 0/1 sign matrix, allocates a 0xc80-byte command buffer, chains the PICA state builders, uploads texture-unit state, and for the curve/fade variant precomputes 64-entry cubic and linear falloff tables (64 * (i/128)^3 and 1 - i/128) before writing the packed 16-bit fixed-point shadow parameters. Falloff loop iVar6=0x40: (i*0.0078125)^3 into local_250 and 1.0-(i*0.0078125) into local_650 (constants 0x3C000000, 0x3F800000); descriptor setters 0x005084F8/0x00508538/0x00508730/0x005081C0/0x005081A0/0x005081B0; floats packed via mantissa>>13 with bias 0x70 (16-bit fixed point), plus 0xE5A477A0/0x801F00AC/0x802F00A9 words. Ends self->f_7a0 = iVar1; self->f_7a4 = iVar3 - iVar1.

signature: unsigned int Gfx_Resource_FindSizeRecord(unsigned short* width, unsigned short* height, unsigned int* desc, unsigned short tag)

signature: int Font_GlyphCache_AddGlyph(FontGlyphCache* self, u32 code character, u32 size, const char* name, u32 owner)

name: Font_GlyphCache_FindGlyph
signature: FontGlyphCell* Font_GlyphCache_FindGlyph(FontGlyphCache* self, const char* key, u32 owner)
